scope: Canonical legacy-source bridge, frozen absolute paths and private namespace only. No production H source validator, actual checkpoint or GPU execution.

findings.title: Unchecked preloaded package search path can execute foreign code before rejection
findings.explanation: check_loaded validates a cached private package using __file__ and _M_primary_root but does not validate its __path__, import spec/search locations, loader or whether this bridge created it. importlib.import_module then resolves the worker via that cached package search path. The post-import location check rejects foreign code only after its top-level code already ran, defeating rejection-before-import of unqualified source.
findings.reproduction: Keep all20 qualified files unchanged. Preload the deterministic private package name with expected canonical __file__/_M_primary_root and foreign __path__. A temporary foreign worker_h writes a sentinel. canonical_primary_worker ultimately raises foreign preloaded primary submodule, but sentinel proves foreign code executed first. Independent run exit0.
findings.impact: A foreign/colliding preloaded private namespace is not safely rejected before import as intended. Its arbitrary top-level code can run before the source-only/qualified-code boundary fails.
findings.requested_change: Reject preloaded namespaces not owned by this loader, and/or validate cached package __path__, spec origin/submodule_search_locations and loader identity against the single canonical package directory before import. Also validate cached submodule provenance before use. Add a regression with matching file/root attributes but foreign search path that asserts no foreign module side effect executes, and a positive owned-cache reuse case.
